Comparison with published clusters

The database-profile run called 12 clusters. 2 met the reciprocal overlap criterion. The default caller profile returned zero clusters on the same input.

A match requires at least 50% overlap in both directions. Jaccard measures the shared fraction of the combined genomic interval coverage.

Explore chromosome 2RInspect matches and misses

How to interpret this run

The input is the first 20,000 reads of a single Ago3 immunoprecipitation library. Reads were mapped only to chromosome 2R, which can change multimapping weights. The published reference combines multiple libraries. Shallow sampling can split a large reference cluster into several shorter calls that each miss the 50% criterion.

The database-profile comparison applies the published proTRAC thresholds to this subset. It omits ncRNA and repeat references. The result measures agreement for this experiment; whole-genome accuracy and biological differences between conditions require a separate study.
